title: Promotion board
subtitle: Review year-end results and move students into the next academic year.
noBranch: Select a branch to open the promotion board.
rolloverDesc: Every saved decision is executed one student at a time: promoted students move up a grade, repeaters stay in their grade, graduates and withdrawals close their file. New enrollments start as pending until the registration fee is settled. Safe to re-run — students already moved are skipped.
rolloverResultDesc: The new year's enrollments are ready. If something looks wrong, you can revert this rollover from the board.
revertDesc: The new year's enrollment is removed, its unpaid bills are cancelled, and each student returns to their previous grade and section with the saved decision kept — you can fix it and run the rollover again. Students who already have attendance, marks or a received payment in the new year are skipped and listed, never unwound silently.
revertResultDesc: These students are back in this year with their saved decision — fix it and run the rollover again when you're ready.
noTargetYear: Create the next academic year first (status: planned).
empty: No students enrolled in this year.
emptyDesc: Enroll students, or pick another academic year.
